buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 2. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 3. Intimation w ill be given to developed sources. 2) Quantities indicated are tentative. There may be change in quantities at the t ime of release of P.O. based on the requirements. 3) Quoted rates shall be firm for a period of one year and any additional quantiti es shall be supplied at the same rate. 4) Quoted rates shall be on F.O.R. BEML-KGF basis.

5) Casting supply condition, surface preparation and painting shall be as per Dr awing/Company standards. 6) Where ever the drawing calls for specific NDT tests, the same are to be carrie d out and suitable reports to be furnished along with supplies. 7) PAYMENT TERMS: Payment term for MSEs is as per MSME act & 100% receipt and acceptance-60 days for all others. 8) firms falling under MSME category should attach latest MSME certificate (regi stration on treds) along with the bid. 9) Delivery schedule:1 Nos each casting by 31.12.2026 other 4 Nos by 31.01.2 027. a) Successful Bidder shall accept to supply the material in staggered lots as per BEML requirements. b) Any new firm interested in supplying / developing the subject item may cont act us through mail id nagesha@bemlltd.in. Development action will be initiated based on BEML requirements after ascertaining the capability of the firm by BE ML. 10) If the Supplier exceeds any agreed delivery date(s) or period(s), Purchaser s hall levy LD for such delay @0.5% per week (7 days) and part thereof, subject t o a maximum of 5% of the value of the delayed portion of the Purchase Order. T he penalty / LD will be charged on the value of the Purchase Order excluding sta tutory levies freight and insurance wherever not included in the price. Impositio n, recovery or Settlement of this LD shall not affect Purchaser’s right to perform ance, compensation and termination of the agreement. 11) BEML reserves the right for Deferment, Re-scheduling, Cancellation/short/Pr e-closure of the Tender and Purchase Orders as and when required. 12) Before dispatch, castings to be offer for TPI/SIT clearance . 13) All other terms shall be as per BEML standard terms & general T&C. .
